verses.20:18: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ

meaning: The root هشش (hshsh) primarily means to break or crumble something dry and brittle, like dry herbage or bread.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
